title: feat(bridge): complete Bitcoin mainnet SPV deposit verifier and local qualification
head: b5f09dfcb794bbc820bcae6ab23df9c099499644
body:
Completes BRIDGE-AUDIT-3.V.2's local Bitcoin implementation on current main `074d1f3628e07ae937117e4b0c700d40adf6e6f1`.

The genesis-anchored mainnet header chain validates 80-byte headers, SHA256d PoW, shared consensus-compatible compact targets, 2,016-block retargets and clamps, cumulative work, parent ancestry, buried versions, MTP and future timestamps. It retains branches, selects strictly greater work, retains incumbent ties, and checks canonical confirmation witnesses. The concrete deposit verifier derives legacy/SegWit txids, satoshi amounts and gateway scripts from transaction bytes; authenticates Merkle inclusion against stored header roots; binds payment index, recipient, amount, route, destination chain and router through a unique OP_RETURN commitment; and requires six confirmations. The adapter verifies route/router configuration, preserves outpoint replay protection through verifier rotation, and exposes source context compatible with the separate draft PR #1155.

Qualified source commit: `5f58baf6dc861939a21119a0fce645060a067518` (tree `7a1bdbacbf446ab92a12bab278ab0fa56c14d73a`, byte-identical to the locally qualified candidate).

Validation:
- 42 unique local tests/invariants PASS; 10,000 fuzz cases. Source CI covers the 41-test published suite; the additional independent outpoint-map replay test passed separately without rerunning existing tests.
- Stateful invariant: 256 runs, 128,000 handler calls, zero handler reverts.
- Every historical header from genesis through 32,256 admitted by the actual Solidity chain, including the genuine difficulty change at 32,256; independent Python checks of all hashes, targets, timestamps, MTP, ancestry, work, retargets and checksums.
- Genuine raw blocks 170 and 481824: legacy and SegWit parsing, actual scripts/amounts/txids, distinct wtxid, independent reconstruction of 1,868 transaction IDs and Merkle trees; historical header tip cross-checked against Blockstream.
- Concrete verifier → Bitcoin adapter → canonical GatewayRouter/route/risk/transfer registries passes success, replay and downstream atomic rollback cases.
- One timestamp test fixture left the clock at the earlier boundary; fixed and reran only that failed test. Passing historical and other source evidence retained.
- Original logs, consolidated results and 51 source checksums: `contracts/test/fixtures/bitcoin/qualification/`. Representation, deployment and trust-model documentation: fixture README.
- Retained historical CI run [43553972819](https://github.com/abvhiael/420-integrated-v0.1/actions/runs/43553972819), original SHA `5287e2845c220b934fdde037e4e4754df881ba3c`; it is not used to qualify changed code.
- Reproducible scoped qualification: `python3 scripts/qualify-bitcoin.py`; offline Python fixture verifiers are separate read-only CI checks. Unrelated contract trees are excluded from compilation.

This qualifies best-known submitted-chain SPV, not full Bitcoin block/script validation or global network-tip freshness. Synthetic deposit/reorg fixtures are explicitly separated from genuine historical mainnet evidence. Production BTC remains APPROVED_INACTIVE. Custody/withdrawals, live synchronization and settlement rehearsal remain the existing activation dependencies. PR #1155 was inspected, not merged or certified by this work. Next canonical step: BRIDGE-AUDIT-3.V.3 — Ethereum (not started).

Published PR head: `b5f09dfcb794bbc820bcae6ab23df9c099499644`. Its differences from production source CI commit `5f58baf6dc861939a21119a0fce645060a067518` are the unrelated sports path-filter exclusion, one additional passing isolated replay-map test, and evidence/docs. No production contract or qualification setting changed; all final qualification source checksums match. These descendants preserve the running Bitcoin job instead of rerunning passing source tests.

Published-source CI:
- [Historical fixture verification 43563876850](https://github.com/abvhiael/420-integrated-v0.1/actions/runs/43563876850): PASS.
- [Bitcoin qualification 43563876854](https://github.com/abvhiael/420-integrated-v0.1/actions/runs/43563876854): PASS — 41 tests, 10,000 fuzz cases, 256 invariant runs / 128,000 handler calls / zero handler reverts.
- Unrelated sports run 43563876866 rejected the Bitcoin diff with `RuntimeError("unrelated source modifications")` before executing its native tests. Its broad interface trigger caused the launch; the final workflow-only commit excludes the Bitcoin interface. No sports tests are rerun by this change. Docs and Indexer jobs were skipped.

Both scoped source CI runs passed. Merged and verified on main at `bb4bd6374d561bcba65345a1dbc86c0c70d53272`. The main tree exactly matches final PR tree `6e4505b255df69b88e00d822f09422766a22b502`; all 51 qualification source checksums match. The final test/evidence/workflow descendants preserve all production bytes from tested source `5f58baf6dc861939a21119a0fce645060a067518`. title: BRIDGE-AUDIT-3.V.4: complete Litecoin Scrypt, consensus and deposit qualification

body:
Completes BRIDGE-AUDIT-3.V.4 locally. Adds exact Scrypt(N=1024,r=1,p=1) verification through bounded permissionless on-chain progress, a genesis-anchored Litecoin header chain with Core retarget/target/timestamp/version rules, greatest-work branch selection and twelve-confirmation ancestry, and a concrete transaction/Merkle/gateway verifier. The adapter enforces verifier route/router/script context and retains message/outpoint replay protection across rotation.

Qualified SHA: `5741522429732437b92b3a9e0d0f659d6b781b1f`, based on current main `bb4bd6374d561bcba65345a1dbc86c0c70d53272`. **30 unique tests pass**, including **7,500 fuzz inputs** and **8,192 stateful calls**. Existing Bitcoin/Ethereum evidence is untouched. The concrete shared router test verifies route failures, risk/transfer rollback and replay.

Genuine evidence: **4,033 consecutive mainnet headers**, independently verified with OpenSSL Scrypt, SHA256d IDs, targets, both changed retarget boundaries, MTP and cumulative work; genuine legacy and SegWit payments; actual HogEx serialization and stripped identity; authenticated output amounts and Merkle paths. Production EVM tests run complete Scrypt for genesis-linked headers and both historical boundary headers (using explicitly seeded historical parent context). Controlled gateway/fork fixtures are clearly distinguished from mined mainnet evidence.

MWEB/HogEx flags, stripped HogAddr/peg-in programs and unsupported MWEB outbound types fail closed. Deposits bind the exact gateway script, destination chain/router/route, payment index, recipient and raw litoshi amount.

[Original qualification logs and results](https://github.com/abvhiael/420-integrated-v0.1/blob/5741522429732437b92b3a9e0d0f659d6b781b1f/contracts/test/fixtures/litecoin/qualification/RESULTS.md) · [Proof format, assumptions and deployment requirements](https://github.com/abvhiael/420-integrated-v0.1/blob/5741522429732437b92b3a9e0d0f659d6b781b1f/contracts/test/fixtures/litecoin/README.md). All four production contracts fit Cancun deployment limits. Exact Scrypt is deliberately split across bounded calls: the standalone genesis qualification consumed ~276M total gas; maximum observed progress-call gas was 5,458,532. Persistent 128 KiB scratch per header and aggregate gas are documented operational costs. There is no trusted hash oracle, signature-based PoW assertion, optimistic challenge or destination consensus upgrade.

No production deployment, custody/withdrawal signing, route activation or historical 420Bridge deposit is claimed. No external blocker remains for local implementation/qualification.

CI is intentionally skipped to preserve passing local evidence and prevent unrelated/redundant workflows. **No GitHub CI run ID is claimed.** A narrowly scoped workflow is provided for future relevant changes, and unrelated documentation/sports interface triggers exclude this slice.

title: feat(bridge): qualify BNB consensus finality and gateway proofs (3.V.6)
head: f28a454008450d5ad5d95e6d07cf1841bf7d1bc5
body:
Implements BSC mainnet fast-finality verification, authenticated delayed validator-set transitions, and transaction/receipt inclusion through the BNB gateway and adapter. Four genuine 20-of-21 BLS certificates finalize historical targets 116,664,000 and 116,664,090 across the real committee change. Ethereum canonical RLP/MPT libraries are included unchanged from qualified ETH SHA 2d766cb0421cdfb3b28a1cd5dc14991b03c16cc3; other open verifier branches are untouched.

The Cancun backend computes BLS12-381 in software through permissionless bounded progress, with checked decompression/hash-to-curve witnesses, subgroup checks, Miller steps and final exponentiation. It trusts neither an RPC finalized label nor an alleged pairing result. Header parsing can be prepared by hash without granting finality authority. The bootstrap explicitly commits to the checkpoint and both epoch snapshots. Software verification is expensive: approximately 41–45 billion gas and thousands of transactions per certificate. Routes remain inactive; this is local cryptographic qualification, not an economical deployment or live-gateway claim.

Validation at f28a454008450d5ad5d95e6d07cf1841bf7d1bc5:
- 29 targeted Solidity tests passed, including 2,500 arithmetic fuzz cases, genuine BLS/finality/transition, malformed/subgroup and cache-authority negatives, historical inclusion, gateway destination/route/replay checks and adapter regression.
- Independent offline oracle reproduces 97 header hashes/seals, all 81 transaction identities and receipts in block 116,663,999, both MPT roots, and four genuine BLS quorum signatures.
- Every progress call in the historical jobs and the prepared 89-header finalization stayed below 30 million gas; runtime/initcode sizes satisfy EIP-170/EIP-3860.
- Source/fixture fingerprints verified. No redundant CI launched: one coherent [skip ci] commit; actual stdout, corrected failure diagnostics, source provenance and bytecode sizes are committed under contracts/test/fixtures/bnb/qualification/.

Report: [BRIDGE-AUDIT-3-V-6-BNB.md](docs/audit/BRIDGE-AUDIT-3-V-6-BNB.md). Historical ordinary payments establish genuine inclusion and are rejected as gateway deposits; controlled local source escrow logs establish gateway semantics. No production 420 gateway deployment/deposit or withdrawal custody is claimed.

Baseline/current main: bb4bd6374d561bcba65345a1dbc86c0c70d53272. Next numbered assignment is BRIDGE-AUDIT-3.V.7; its title is absent from the checked-in roadmap and matching issues, and it has not been started.

title: BRIDGE-AUDIT-3.V.8: qualify native TRON solidification and TRX deposit proofs
head: 97b1323b27d8208dba3843734cf2275b63e47bfd
body:
TronBridgeAdapter420 previously delegated finality to an interface with only mock evidence. Implement TronFinalityVerifier420: validate native protobuf headers, SHA-256/block IDs, SR witness-permission signatures, ordered 27-SR schedules, consecutive ancestry and 19-distinct-SR solidification under explicitly authenticated bounded checkpoint/snapshot profiles. Authenticate the full transaction protobuf Merkle leaf, including execution results; accept atomic native TransferContract only. Bind approved gateway, positive int64 sun amount and a signed destination chain/router/route/recipient memo. Extend the verifier ABI and independently enforce those destination bindings in the adapter, closing route substitution; retain transaction/message replay state.

Qualification: 48 unique passing Solidity tests, including 5,000 fuzz cases; 1,099 consecutive genuine mainnet headers anchored to genesis, all producer signatures/schedules checked independently, plus two native transaction signatures/full leaves. Solidity solidifies historical chunks through height 1045 and authenticates its 580,000,000,000-sun transfer; rejects relabelling the ordinary payment as a bridge deposit. Includes delegated SR keys, 18/repeated producer rejection, conflicting branches, RPC-only claims, failed/tampered execution results, protobuf/amount boundaries, destination substitution and replay. Production verifier runtime 13,451 bytes and adapter 3,723; deployment and tested per-call gas bounds pass.

Retained logs, exact source fingerprints, raw historical captures, generated protobuf/ABI fixtures, expected values, provenance and SHA-256 manifests are committed. One newly added test helper failed on a fixed protobuf-length assumption; parsed field boundaries repaired it and only that test reran. Final exact-upstream config-byte correction required only offline regeneration and the historical owner to rerun. All unrelated passing evidence is preserved. CI run IDs: none; no redundant Actions run requested ([skip ci]). Dedicated TRON paths and existing docs exclusions scope future qualification.

Qualified published SHA: 97b1323b27d8208dba3843734cf2275b63e47bfd. Verified remote tree ab3fc463be9242f7153d2dafe8709c4d30da0b06 is byte-identical to locally qualified commit 020ecdeb99f16d334902e61bd6e1c3dd256efbac. Base main 97413f2eea862d5f2ec3117313cd3beb15a634f4. One coherent published implementation commit.

Trust model: governance authenticates canonical checkpoints, ordered active SRs and permission keys over windows ending before maintenance/permission/consensus changes. This verifies native producer signatures, not bridge-domain attestations, and does not autonomously replay elections. No production profile, gateway/custody account, deployment or route activation is claimed. The native TRX route remains inactive under its existing activation gates. Matched new adapter/verifier ABI is required. Detailed requirement mapping: docs/audit/BRIDGE-AUDIT-3-V-8-TRON.md.

title: BRIDGE-AUDIT-3.V.9: qualify native XRPL validation quorum and SHAMap payments
head: d37d35a18668d68cc960aae6be19441f241a7e2a
body:
XrplBridgeAdapter420 previously trusted a mock-only verifier boundary. Implement native full-validation quorum verification under explicit mainnet UNL/master-to-manifest-signing-key snapshots, canonical ledger hashing, SHA-512Half and key-directed 16-way transaction+metadata SHAMap proofs. Require committed tesSUCCESS, positive native drops, approved AccountID/tag/route and a signed destination chain/router/route/recipient memo. Reject partial payments, issued currency, contradictory delivered amounts, RPC-only validated assertions and replay. Extend the interface and independently check certified destination bindings in the adapter, preventing route substitution.

Genuine evidence: authenticate both mainnet publisher lists against the upstream publisher pins, publisher manifests/list signatures and all validator master/ephemeral manifest signatures. Ledger 108335815 has 34 unique trusted native full validations under a verified 35-master roster (28 required). Independently reconstruct its complete 74-transaction SHAMap root. Solidity verifies native quorum, header hash, two-level SHAMap proof and the successful 24,809,848-drop Payment with tag 282161781; ordinary historical payments cannot be relabelled as bridge deposits. Raw captures, native messages, generated proofs, expected values and checksums are committed.

Actual qualification: 49 unique passing Solidity tests, including 5,000 fuzz cases; 21 independent SHA-512Half padding/boundary vectors; native DER/canonical flag, metadata/result, UNL/quorum, amount, tag and destination/replay adversarial checks. Initial 43 passing tests and six new passing checks retained separately; no passing Solidity test reruns or test failures. Only the changed offline verifier reran after adding the explicit upstream publisher-pin check, with generated proof bytes unchanged. Production bounds: verifier runtime 19,130 / init 23,695 bytes, SHA-512Half runtime 4,146 / init 4,173, adapter runtime 3,792 / init 4,201. Tested individual validation/deposit gas <30M. CI run IDs: none; [skip ci] preserves qualified local evidence. Dedicated XRPL path filters and existing docs exclusions scope future runs.

Restore the SHA-512 source/license that current main's Solana imports and retained source fingerprint referenced but did not contain. Vendored unchanged from mel-project/ed25519-sol@3b36ec8c361c8fe29e6eff10019521454f888ff5; SHA-256 exactly 96a74497a31f38c57bbf989e66575ae72338bbce950cbbf9bc202cb52cd91eb8, matching the earlier qualification. XRPL reuses and independently qualifies this primitive; no Solana source behavior or prior evidence is replaced.

Qualified published SHA: d37d35a18668d68cc960aae6be19441f241a7e2a. Published tree 4ed0e4f762f842412e6c7d88c6d424f5b29c252b verified byte-identical to locally qualified commit a28b45530711cbe30c4c90c20f6e94911cfda955. Base main 97413f2eea862d5f2ec3117313cd3beb15a634f4. One coherent published implementation commit.

Trust boundary: governance authenticates the UNL/current manifest mapping and explicit ledger/Ripple-time ranges; quorum is at least ceil(80%) with no automatic unauthenticated NegativeUNL reduction. Native validation signatures provide finality, not a 420 committee or RPC label. No autonomous publisher/manifest/amendment replay is claimed. Repository/historical requirements are qualified; no production deployment, operating current UNL profile, gateway/custody account or route activation is claimed. Existing XRP activation gates remain unchanged and inactive; deploy a matched new adapter/verifier ABI pair.

- Full native raw-only mainnet validation through the same hardened tip with assumevalid=0, zero peers and retained own-prefix/binary trace lineage. Canonical trust 8070163640872156 matches the independent replay. Native and independent selected kernel/modifier/checksum data agree.
- Production runtime sizes: verifier 17722 bytes; adapter 3864 bytes.

This explicitly trusts the configured AuthenticatedCheckpoint420 native replay authority for canonical chain selection, full script/reward validity, spent state and modifier ancestry. It is not a permissionless EVM PoS light client or irreversible source finality. Genuine historical ordinary transactions lack the new signed bridge comment and cannot be credited as 420 deposits; controlled bridge-flow tests are clearly separate. The native observer was corrected to this client's supported getblockhash(height) method after its full block validation completed; observations were exported from that actual completed node without rerunning validation. Performance memoization and equivalent signature fast path preserve native rules and OpenSSL fallback; source/build/patch/dependency pins and differential evidence are retained.
